_about: DL-232 / SSYS-055: the hosted chat and Settings share admitted preferences; DL-234: the chat shows live thinking under this row's choice. Current-chat ELI5 stays in its chat sheet. Column width and pin choices remain layout state.

general.interaction.chat-history-list.label: History in new workspaces
general.interaction.chat-history-list.help: Starts as a flyout or pinned beside the messages. A workspace's saved choice always wins.

general.interaction.thought-stream.label: Show thinking
general.interaction.thought-stream.help: Shown when the model shares its reasoning. While it thinks folds it to one line once the answer starts; Always open keeps it beside the answer.
